name: Data Browser Storage Tank (Web)

endpoints.description: List/filter data record Storage Tank (gabungan sync mobile & input web) dengan pagination
Ekspor data Storage Tank terfilter ke CSV/Excel

success_schema.note: Response body adalah file stream/binary (CSV kolom: Storage Tank ID, Date, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Status), bukan JSON

error_codes.condition: dataset terlalu besar (> 50000 baris) atau error saat proses ekspor

business_logic: 1. Validate query params (date_from/date_to) -> if date_from > date_to: throw InvalidDateRangeException -> 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE, filter tidak diterapkan
2. Build query (buildFilteredQuery()): storage-tank-record WHERE business_unit_id matches (via station->business_unit_id, if provided) AND date BETWEEN date_from/date_to (if provided)

4. filled_slot_count per record dihitung via withCount('storageTankDetails as filled_slot_count', ...) dengan constraint OR across seluruh 17 kolom bacaan (cpo_sounding_depth_mm, water_dip_bottom_depth_mm, net_oil_depth_mm, oil_temperature_top_c, oil_temperature_middle_c, oil_temperature_bottom_c, average_temperature_c, calculated_volume_m3, calculated_weight_mt, ffa_percent, moisture_content_percent, impurities_dirt_percent, dobi_index, steam_heating_valve_status, tank_structural_condition, inspector_name, findings) NOT NULL -- bisa jadi SAMA DENGAN total baris pada record (jika semua baris yang ditambahkan sudah terisi) atau lebih kecil (jika ada baris ditambahkan tapi belum diisi bacaan apapun)
5. Return list (toListRow() map: id, storage_tank_id, date, filled_slot_count, status) + pagination metadata

6. On export: re-run query filter yang sama tanpa pagination (buildFilteredQuery()->with(['checkedBy:id,name','acknowledgedBy:id,name'])), enforce EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT=50000 -> if total > limit: throw ExportFailedException -> 422 EXPORT_FAILED
7. Generate CSV via streamDownload() (header: Storage Tank ID, Date, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Status), return file stream untuk didownload user

data_operations.description: SELECT records dengan filter tanggal/business_unit, dipaginasi
SELECT records dengan filter yang sama, unpaginated, untuk keperluan ekspor
COUNT baris storage-tank-detail (dengan minimal 1 dari 17 kolom bacaan non-null) per record untuk kolom filled_slot_count

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 200 dengan data: [], FE tampilkan empty state dengan opsi reset filter
Navigasi client-side ke Detail Storage Tank (Web), bukan panggilan API tambahan

business_rules_applied: Data mencakup hasil sync mobile & input web
Daftar termuat <=2 detik untuk dataset normal
filled_slot_count dihitung dari baris yang punya minimal satu dari 17 kolom bacaan terisi (bisa sama dengan atau lebih kecil dari total baris pada record)

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE when date_from is greater than date_to
unit_test_cases.given: request query params date_from='2026-08-20', date_to='2026-08-10' passed to StorageTankRecordService::listRecords() (via buildFilteredQuery())
unit_test_cases.expect: throw InvalidDateRangeException / return HTTP 422 with error_code INVALID_DATE_RANGE; filter is not applied to the query

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 EXPORT_FAILED when export dataset exceeds EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT (50000) or an error occurs during file generation
unit_test_cases.given: StorageTankRecordService::export() query returns a dataset exceeding 50000 rows, or the CSV writer throws an error
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ExportFailedException / return HTTP 422 with error_code EXPORT_FAILED

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: valid date_from <= date_to, valid business_unit_id, page/per_page provided; buildFilteredQuery()->withCount() returns paginated records with filled_slot_count computed
unit_test_cases.expect: return { data: [...storage-tank-record rows], meta: { page, per_page, total, total_pages } } with HTTP 200

unit_test_cases.description: computes filled_slot_count as count of detail rows with at least one non-null reading/status column, not simply the total row count on the record
unit_test_cases.given: a record has 3 storage_tank_detail rows (added by the user via Tambah Baris), 2 of which have at least one non-null value among the 17 reading/status columns and 1 fully null (added but not yet filled)

screen_dependencies.reason: Aksi Tambah Data membuka form input web

implementation_notes: Ekspor sebaiknya dijalankan sebagai proses async/background job untuk dataset besar; NFR <=2 detik hanya berlaku untuk list, tidak eksplisit untuk export
Data source gabungan: record hasil sync manual dari mobile + record input langsung dari web (screen-116)

filled_slot_count dihitung via withCount('storageTankDetails as filled_slot_count', fn(q) => q->where(fn(q2) => q2->orWhereNotNull(...))) -- mirrors EffluentPlantRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern with an inner OR-NOT-NULL constraint across all 17 non-time_slot columns (including the 1 enum status column)
Stasiun ini TIDAK memiliki tabel referensi Target Operasional -- tidak ada seeder/model StorageTankOperationalTarget

1 kolom enum pada storage_tank_detail (steam_heating_valve_status, nilai closed/open_1_4/open_1_2) memakai CHECK constraint SQLite (via Laravel enum()) -- string kosong ('') TIDAK valid untuk kolom ini dan akan gagal constraint; StorageTankRecordService::normalizeDetails() mengonversi '' menjadi null sebelum INSERT/UPDATE (lihat screen-116's business_logic), mitigasi yang sama dipakai Kernel Dispatch dan Effluent Plant

Web Livewire component DataBrowserStorageTank menggunakan StorageTankRecordService langsung (bukan HTTP call ke API controller), route name 'data.storage-tank'; export dispatched sebagai link browser-navigable (bukan AJAX/blob)
